parameters.value:
import json
import re

def analyze_alert(raw_str):
    # 1. Regex Telemetry Extraction
    mitre_ids = list(set(re.findall(r'T\d{4}(?:\.\d+)?', raw_str)))
    
    rule_match = re.search(r'"rule_id"\s*:\s*"?(\d+)"?', raw_str) or re.search(r'"id"\s*:\s*"?((?:100|60)\d{3})"?', raw_str)
    rule_id = str(rule_match.group(1)) if rule_match else ""

    ip_match = re.search(r'"(?:srcip|ipAddress|IpAddress)"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', raw_str, re.IGNORECASE)
    src_ip = ip_match.group(1) if ip_match else ""

    user_match = re.search(r'"(?:targetUserName|dstuser|srcuser)"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', raw_str, re.IGNORECASE)
    target_user = user_match.group(1) if user_match else ""
    
    # Hex-encoded braces to prevent Shuffle template collisions
    agent_id_match = re.search(r'"agent"\s*:\s*\x7b[^\x7d]*?"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', raw_str, re.DOTALL)
    agent_id = str(agent_id_match.group(1)) if agent_id_match else "unknown"

    agent_match = re.search(r'"name"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', raw_str)
    agent_name = agent_match.group(1) if agent_match else "unknown"

    # 2. Universal Rule ID Fallback Matrix
    fallback_map = {
        "60204": ["T1110"], "60122": ["T1110"], "5716": ["T1110"],  
        "5145": ["T1135"],  "4624": ["T1078"],  "4688": ["T1059"],  
        "4625": ["T1110"],  "100001": ["T1110"], "100002": ["T1003"], 
        "100011": ["T1558"], "100012": ["T1558"], "100030": ["T1135"], 
        "100031": ["T1135"], "100041": ["T1021"], "100050": ["T1087"], 
        "100051": ["T1087"], "100061": ["T1021"], "100062": ["T1047"], 
        "100071": ["T1053"], "100072": ["T1543"], "100081": ["T1098"], 
        "100082": ["T1098"], "100090": ["T1021"], "100091": ["T1486"], 
        "100101": ["T1021"], "100111": ["T1003"], "100121": ["T1558"], 
        "100131": ["T1110"]  
    }

    if not mitre_ids and rule_id in fallback_map:
        mitre_ids = fallback_map[rule_id]

    # 3. MITRE Containment Actions
    mitre_map = {
        "T1110": {"action": "IP_BLOCK", "target": src_ip, "command": "netsh", "prompt": f"MITRE T1110 (Brute Force): Block IP {src_ip}?"},
        "T1046": {"action": "IP_BLOCK", "target": src_ip, "command": "netsh", "prompt": f"MITRE T1046 (Scanning): Block IP {src_ip}?"},
        "T1135": {"action": "IP_BLOCK", "target": src_ip, "command": "netsh", "prompt": f"MITRE T1135 (Share Enum): Block IP {src_ip}?"},
        "T1087": {"action": "IP_BLOCK", "target": src_ip, "command": "netsh", "prompt": f"MITRE T1087 (LDAP Enum): Block IP {src_ip}?"},

        "T1003": {"action": "USER_LOCK", "target": target_user, "command": "disable-ad-user", "prompt": f"MITRE T1003 (Credential Dumping): Lock {target_user}?"},
        "T1078": {"action": "USER_LOCK", "target": target_user, "command": "disable-ad-user", "prompt": f"MITRE T1078 (Valid Accounts): Lock {target_user}?"},
        "T1558": {"action": "USER_LOCK", "target": target_user, "command": "disable-ad-user", "prompt": f"MITRE T1558 (Kerberos Abuse): Lock {target_user}?"},
        "T1098": {"action": "USER_LOCK", "target": target_user, "command": "disable-ad-user", "prompt": f"MITRE T1098 (Privilege Escalation): Lock {target_user}?"},

        "T1204": {"action": "HOST_ISOLATION", "target": agent_name, "command": "host-isolation", "prompt": f"MITRE T1204 (User Execution): Isolate {agent_name}?"},
        "T1486": {"action": "HOST_ISOLATION", "target": agent_name, "command": "host-isolation", "prompt": f"MITRE T1486 (Ransomware): Isolate {agent_name}?"},
        "T1021": {"action": "HOST_ISOLATION", "target": agent_name, "command": "host-isolation", "prompt": f"MITRE T1021 (Lateral Movement): Isolate {agent_name}?"},
        "T1047": {"action": "HOST_ISOLATION", "target": agent_name, "command": "host-isolation", "prompt": f"MITRE T1047 (WMI Execution): Isolate {agent_name}?"},
        "T1053": {"action": "HOST_ISOLATION", "target": agent_name, "command": "host-isolation", "prompt": f"MITRE T1053 (Scheduled Task): Isolate {agent_name}?"},
        "T1543": {"action": "HOST_ISOLATION", "target": agent_name, "command": "host-isolation", "prompt": f"MITRE T1543 (Service Creation): Isolate {agent_name}?"}
    }

    decision = {
        "action": "PASSIVE_LOG", "target": "none", "command": "none",
        "prompt": "No predefined MITRE containment. Passive logging only."
    }

    # 4. Decision Routing
    for technique in mitre_ids:
        base_technique = technique.split(".")[0]
        if base_technique in mitre_map:
            temp_decision = mitre_map[base_technique]
            if temp_decision["action"] == "IP_BLOCK" and not src_ip: continue
            if temp_decision["action"] == "USER_LOCK" and not target_user: continue
            decision = temp_decision
            break

    return {
        "success": True,
        "action": decision["action"],
        "target": decision["target"],
        "command": decision["command"],
        "prompt": decision["prompt"],
        "agent_name": agent_name,
        "agent_id": agent_id,
        "srcip": src_ip,
        "username": target_user,
        "rule_id": rule_id,
        "mitre_ids": ", ".join(mitre_ids)
    }

# ==================================================
# SHUFFLE EXECUTION ENTRY POINT
# ==================================================
try:
    raw_input_data = '''$exec'''
    result = analyze_alert(raw_input_data)
    print(json.dumps(result))
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({"success": False, "action": "ERROR", "prompt": f"Regex Execution Error: {e}"}))
